description: Sends the callback request that the user confirmed on the card shown by prepare_callback to the provider's team: one entry in the provider's request list and one email to its service desk. It is called by the card's send button with the request_id the card carries, once per request. It does NOT create or change a request, and it needs a request that the user prepared in this consultation.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

request_id.description: The request_id carried by the card.

name: send_callback
title: Send the confirmed callback request
